BombVault 10.6.3 moves to GlimStone 4.8.1. Storage locations, sign-ins, registries and notification channels each sit on a row of their own, the add windows pick from GlimStone's shared catalogs, and a snapshot schedule takes up a fraction of the room it used to.

## 🎨 Design

- **Follows GlimStone 4.8.1.** Adding a storage location, a notification channel, a container registry or an MCP client opens a window of tiles from GlimStone's catalogs, with groups, a search and many more logos than before, among them Koofr, PikPak, Sia, RustFS, OpenDrive, TeleBox and Synology C2. The catch-all tile of each window stands last, and S3 compatible storage is now called **Custom S3**.
- **One row per connection.** Every storage location, sign-in, container registry and notification channel is a row with its logo, a status line and its buttons at the end. A channel keeps its on and off switch in the row and opens its fields in a window behind **Edit**. A sign-in shows **Default** as a badge, and **Make default** and **Remove** sit in its window.
- **Tidier forms.** In every add and edit window the label stands on the left and its field on the right, all fields start on one edge, and the window keeps its width from the first step to the last. **More settings** stay folded until you open them, or until one of them holds a value of its own.
- **Smaller snapshot schedules.** A schedule shows its target, a line with its plan, its switch and its buttons. **Edit** opens the fields. On the Snapshots page the note on what a snapshot is moved to the end and goes away with **Got it**.
- **The same words everywhere.** All 42 languages follow GlimStone's glossary for signing in, accounts, sessions and two-factor authentication.

## ⚡ Improved

- **A new login password is typed twice.** **Save** stays off until both entries match.
- **Fresh building blocks.** The fortress kit 1.0.5, React Router 7.18.6 and Vitest 5.1.1.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Recoveries reach every channel.** A channel set to failures only now also hears when a failed backup succeeds again.
- **Pairing is steadier.** A call whose check on a new member was cut short is dropped and can be tried again, instead of being refused.
